description: Receive and verify Token.io webhooks. Use when setting up Token.io webhook handlers, debugging Ed25519 signature verification, subscribing to webhook config via PUT /webhook/config, or handling open banking / A2A payment events like PAYMENT_STATUS_CHANGED, REFUND_STATUS_CHANGED, VRP_STATUS_CHANGED, and VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT_CREDIT_RECEIVED. Note: Token.io does NOT use HMAC or Standard Webhooks — it signs the raw body with an ASYMMETRIC Ed25519 signature in the token-signature header, verified with your member's Ed25519 public key.
